critical_code_review_comments: autonomous_routes.py:132 — pursuable.sort uses lexical priority strings (P0<P1<P2) which happens to sort correctly but relies on lexicographic ordering; safer to map to int weights.

autonomous_routes.py:186-201 — in live mode, when preparing actions the code calls gate_check with action='prepare' for non-critical wake/create_task actions; ensure Gate rules for 'prepare' exist or every action becomes blocked. Current data shows executed actions in live cycle #3, so OK, but action='prepare' is generic and may bypass finer-grained gates. Consider distinct action names per operation type.
provider_layer.py:126 — total_calls_logged uses count_documents({}) without a 24h filter despite variable name 'calls_24h'. Misleading; either rename or add {timestamp:{$gte: ...}}.

finance_routes.py:98 — same-admin second approval returns 409 as expected. Good. However the audit_logs collection is not written for approve/reject; only journal. Consider adding log_authz for full audit parity.

core_routes.py:191-195 — /monitoring/health PUBLISHES monitoring.action events on every call for each agent in error → can flood the event bus if the endpoint is polled by the UI. Consider throttling (dedupe or last_published_at guard).

identity_routes.py:52 — set_cookie uses samesite='none' with secure=True — correct for cross-site preview URL. Ensure the ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD are strong in prod (currently CVLNfactory2026! which is fine for preview).

knowledge_sources_routes.py:104 — ks_id uses `ks-{count+1:04d}` which is race-condition-prone if two ingests happen concurrently (both may compute the same next id). Use $inc on a counter or uuid suffix.

founder_council.py:32-36 — agt000_available excludes 'termine' but not 'sommeil'; a sleeping AGT-000 is considered available. Verify this matches the intent (Laurent said fallback only when AGT-000 unavailable — should sommeil count as unavailable?).
autonomous_routes.py:214 — create_task duplicate guard uses regex `^\[OBJ\] {code}` which is correct, but relies on title format never changing. Consider matching on objective_id directly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (/runtime cards + run-cycle-btn + 9-step expansion + nav + main pages)

Only minor test-authoring hiccups during first run: (a) `.local` TLD rejected by pydantic email-validator → switched to `.example.com`; (b) objectives.priority is a P0/P1/P2 string (not integer) — corrected payload; (c) initial live-cycle assertion tied to our specific test objective was too strict because the cycle only processes top-5 by (priority, oldest last_activity) and existing P0 objectives with older activity took the slots — relaxed to assert ANY escalate_validation with a validation_request_id appears (mechanism validated end-to-end).
